summary: @EmporessAmanda lived up in Plymouth for long while. First week long power outage. Then the October blizzard in Niantic. Swear my kids missed (or got three) Halloweens in a row. Frequency crazy.. Now in East Haddam. All well water
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@EmporessAmanda lived up in Plymouth for long while. First week long power outage. Then the October blizzard in Niantic. Swear my kids missed (or got three) Halloweens in a row.

Frequency crazy.. Now in East Haddam. All well water
